## What's Changed
* Fix stubBaseUrls in Config V3 generating unparseable URLs by @StarKhan6368 in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2547
* validate snapshots before we do any heavy lifting by @ketan in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2589
* Fix regression in handling of 4xx status codes beyond 400 by @joelrosario in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2592
* Remove problematic usages of java.net.URL by @sahilm in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2567
* Implement example preprocessor support by @StarKhan6368 in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2597
* Bump to latest reporter to get bug fixes by @sahilm in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2600
* Improve SOAP xsi:type matching for WSDL mocks by @joelrosario in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2602
* Update specmaticGradlePluginVersion to v0.15.14 by @specmatic-builder in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2599
* Update dependency io.kotest:kotest-assertions-core-jvm to v6.2.1 by @specmatic-builder in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2588
* Reuse license HTTP URL validator for validateTestOrStubUri by @sahilm in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2601
* feat: add spec-level coverage metrics to CTRF reports by @Sushant092003 in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2585
* Remove Deprecated Assertion and ExampleProcessor capabilites by @StarKhan6368 in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2603
* Substitution support in tests and interpolated substitutions by @StarKhan6368 in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2604
* Stop linting inline 405 and 415 examples as undeclared request variants by @joelrosario in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2605
* Optimize WSDL choice-group parsing for XML patterns by @joelrosario in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2607
* Lenient substitutions and internal changes by @StarKhan6368 in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2606
* Composite substitutions and dictionary fallback generation by @StarKhan6368 in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2608
* Ensure basedOn methods can work with substitution tokens by @StarKhan6368 in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2609
* Ensure data is passed to substitution in ScenarioAsTest by @StarKhan6368 in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2610


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/compare/2.48.0...2.49.0
